# CODE {#sec-code}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_setup.R")
```

The full text of every script in `r spec$script_dir`, in the order the version runs them (analysis, figures and tables, provenance record). Each script's hash is compared with the one recorded in the provenance record.

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (s in script_run_order(names(spec$script_hashes))) {
  path <- file.path(spec$script_dir, s)
  hash <- rlang::hash_file(file.path(root, path))
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", path))
  cat(sprintf("Hash `%s` (%s)\n\n", hash,
              if (identical(hash, spec$script_hashes[[s]])) "matches the provenance record"
              else "**does not match the provenance record**"))
  cat("~~~~{.r}\n", paste(readLines(file.path(root, path), warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), "\n~~~~\n\n\\clearpage\n", sep = "")
}
```
